definitions: A polite way of saying 'What did you say?' or 'Could you repeat that?'
An apology for a mistake or an impolite remark.
An expression of polite disagreement or surprise.
examples: I beg your pardon, I didn't quite catch that.
I beg your pardon, I didn't mean to interrupt.
I beg your pardon, but I think you're mistaken.
